title: Shopping is shifting to AI agents, so our store must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ). Walmart opened to outside AI agents while Amazon blocks them; Amex launched agent verification. Q3 PC shipments fell 21% (Counterpoint) amid memory-driven price inflation.

points.headline: AI agents are becoming a shopping channel, and retailers are setting the rules
points.detail: Walmart lets AI agents buy with spending controls while Amazon blocks them; Amex launched agent purchase verification. We need a stance on agent access to our store.

points.headline: AI is already how many shoppers discover products, so content must work for AI
points.detail: NIQ: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery; Gartner: 34% of US consumers would use GenAI for holiday gift ideas. Our catalog and content should be machine-readable.

points.headline: Memory costs and weak demand squeeze PC pricing and Q4 planning
points.detail: Counterpoint: Q3 PC shipments fell 21% with a 27% Q4 decline forecast, and memory shortages drive record price inflation. Plan promotions, pricing and inventory for lower volume and thinner margins.

points.headline: Best Buy joins TikTok Shop, and holiday spend stays selective
points.detail: Best Buy is selling on TikTok Shop for its biggest holiday season; Adobe forecasts $275.1B US online holiday sales, while Circana finds shoppers spending selectively. Test our TikTok presence and value-led offers.
